item.text: The code already has separate local, remote, and discovered-endpoint helpers, but the dispatch is inconsistent with the requested selection rules. I’m reading those branches and their tests now to preserve existing behavior where it matches the new contract.

The local credential branch now runs before kube_service lookup, while unknown clusters still produce `NotFound`; remote contexts retain their separate reverse tunnel path. Endpoint dialing now uses the explicit endpoint address/server ID and only records the selected address after a successful connection. I’m checking request setup and compiling the package to catch API or test assumptions.
The package test command is still running without output, likely building the larger Go package. I’m letting it finish, then I’ll inspect the diff and update the checkpoint with the result.
